channel.title: NoBadge Updates
channel.description: Signed NoBadge updates. A purchase license is required.

item.title: NoBadge 0.1.48
item.description: Fix badge restoration being rejected when macOS removes a legacy Messages service registration. The real Messages settings remain verified. Also fix premature badge restoration completion. NoBadge now keeps recovery pending until the macOS notification service has restarted and both cached and stored badge settings are verified. Original settings remain available for retry if verification fails. Quick hide/show actions may take a moment while macOS restarts its notification service. The explicit Recover missing badges option and supported macOS families are unchanged.
